resources.string: This app manages saved Italian tax codes (Codice Fiscale) and barcodes. Operational Patterns: Use getMyTaxCode to retrieve or phonetically spell out the owner tax code. Use getContactTaxCode with parameter name to retrieve or spell out a saved contact tax code. Use openMyTaxCodeBarcode to open the owner barcode bottom sheet. Use openContactTaxCodeBarcode with parameter name to open a contact barcode bottom sheet. Constraints: Searches only tax codes and contacts already saved in TaxCode.
TaxCode retrieves saved Italian tax codes (Codice Fiscale), spells them phonetically, and displays their barcodes.
TaxCode - Tax code retrieval, phonetic spelling, and barcode display
